prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: the top of old mossy stone walls seen from above: grey stones mostly covered with moss and small ferns. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: overhead tops of old mossy stone walls, irregular grey stone blocks mostly overgrown with rich moss and occasional tiny ferns. Fill entire canvas edge-to-edge with just the repeating surface; no framing, borders, characters, props, writing, focal point. IMPORTANT tile continuity: left boundary visually and geometrically continues onto right boundary, and top boundary continues onto bottom boundary, including stone joints, moss patches, and palette; even distribution of detail. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art JRPG look, manually placed pixel clusters with hard uniformly sized square art pixels, approximately 8 by 8 display pixels per art pixel; consistent pixel grid, no antialiasing, blur, soft brush, photographic texture, random noise or checkerboard dithering. Strong readable connected clusters of 3–10 art pixels, deliberate masonry shapes. Earthy rich palette, 4–6 discrete shades per material; shadow colors lean more saturated plum/purple-red, highlights warm yellow-ochre. Camera orthographic straight from above, 16-bit RPG map viewpoint without perspective. Clean neutral base colors and soft even overcast upper-left illumination; NO cast shadows, night tint, light sources, glow or vignette.
